description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkDirectiveParser, specifically testing its ability to parse directive JSON strings and handle various cases such as ignoring non-directive lines and tracking unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: A test case class using XCTest to verify the behavior of TalkDirectiveParser parsing functions.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine
methods.description: Tests parsing of a proper directive with voice and once fields, and verifies stripped text.

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Ensures that lines without directives are correctly identified and return nil directive.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields
methods.description: Verifies behavior when directive JSON contains unknown fields, ensuring directive is nil and text is preserved.

methods.name: testParsesExtendedOptions
methods.description: Tests parsing of extended options in the directive JSON, verifying all fields including voice_id, model_id, rate, stability, etc.

methods.name: testSkipsLeadingEmptyLinesWhenParsingDirective
methods.description: Checks that leading empty lines are correctly skipped and the directive is parsed as expected.

methods.name: testTracksUnknownKeys
methods.description: Verifies that unknown keys in the directive JSON are tracked properly in 'unknownKeys'.
